events.title: Indonesia Rate Decision Due On Wednesday
events.description: The central bank in Indonesia will wrap up it monetary policy meeting on Wednesday and then announce its decision on interest rates, highlighting a light day for Asia-Pacific economic activity.

events.title: South Korea Producer Prices Rise 0.2% In September
events.description: Producer prices in South Korea were up 0.2 percent on month in September, the Bank of Korea said on Wednesday - up from 0.1 percent in August.

events.title: U.S. Dollar Dips Amid Easing Inflation Concerns Following Reports Of A Possible U.S.-Iran Deal
events.description: The U.S. Dollar value edged lower on Tuesday after a report indicated that Pakistan and Qatar have presented a proposal to end the U.S.-Iran conflict for which both sides have offered their preliminary approval.

events.title: Canadian Stock Market Rallies As Tech Leads Recovery
events.description: Canada's benchmark S&P/TSX Composite Index rose 226.70 points to 36,155.33 on Tuesday, driven by gains in technology, financials, and healthcare sectors. Oil's retreat eased inflation concerns while lower bond yields supported improved risk sentiment.

events.title: Swiss Market Ends On Firm Note
events.description: After inching up a bit early on in the session on Tuesday, the Switzerland stock market's SMI moved along the flat line till a little past mid afternoon before edging higher to end the day on a firm note.

events.title: European Markets Close Weak Despite Mid-Session Recovery
events.description: Major European indices ended lower Tuesday amid concerns over civil unrest in France and Italy, elevated oil prices from Middle East tensions, and worries about AI stock valuations. Germany's producer price inflation accelerated sharply.

events.title: U.S. Pending Home Sales Plunge Much More Than Expected In September
events.description: Pending home sales in the U.S. plunged by much more than expected in the month of September, according to a report released by the National Association of Realtors on Tuesday. NAR said its pending home sales plummeted by 7.3 percent to 66.0 in September after rising by 0.3 percent to 71.2 in August. Economists had expected pending home sales to fall by 0.4 percent.

events.title: UK Unemployment Rate Unexpectedly Drops
events.description: The UK unemployment rate unexpectedly declined in the three months to August amid falling job vacancies and a moderate increase in pay growth, adding prospects for a Bank of England interest rate hike in November. The ILO unemployment rate stood at 4.7 percent in the June to August period compared to 4.9 percent in the preceding period.

events.title: U.S. Housing Starts Unexpectedly Extend Nosedive In September
events.description: A report released by the Commerce Department on Monday unexpectedly showed an extended nosedive in new residential construction in the U.S. in the month of September. The Commerce Department said housing starts plunged by 5.2 percent to an annual rate of 1.221 million in September after plummeting by 5.9 percent to a revised rate of 1.288 million in August.

events.title: Canadian Stocks Set To Open Lower Amid Inflation, Geopolitical Concerns
events.description: Canadian equities face headwinds from elevated inflation, weak precious metals, and Middle East tensions. The S&P/TSX Composite Index fell 0.68% Monday. Oil prices surged 4.15% on Houthi attacks.

events.title: U.S. Housing Starts Unexpectedly Plunge 5.2% September
events.description: A report released by the Commerce Department on Monday unexpectedly showed an extended nosedive in new residential construction in the U.S. in the month of September.

events.title: German ZEW Economic Sentiment Deteriorates
events.description: German economic confidence deteriorated more than expected in October as private spending and investment remained weak due to high energy prices, survey results from the Mannheim-based Centre for European Economic Research, or ZEW, showed Tuesday. The economic confidence index fell to a three-month low of 28.1 in October from 34.7 in the previous month. The score was forecast to drop to 30.2.

events.title: Pound Rises As U.K. Unemployment Rate Falls
events.description: The British pound strengthened against other major currencies in the European session on Tuesday, after the U.K. unemployment rate declined in the three months to August.
